segments.title: 第33章 電腦密碼
segments.content:
Li Luo was typing for a while when his QQ icon suddenly started bouncing, indicating a new message.

He glanced at it and saw that Xu Youyu had replied to him.

So he clicked open the chat window and saw the reply from "Sleeping Early Makes You Taller."

She actually called him "Big shot"?

Seeing this form of address, Li Luo was a bit stunned.

In his past life, it was always Li Luo who called Xu Youyu that. He never expected it to be the other way around in this life.

In author circles, if you weren't very familiar with another author, it was customary out of politeness to first call them "Big shot," regardless of how well their book was doing.

After getting a bit more familiar, you would call them by an abbreviation of their pen name, followed by the character "Ju."

For example, "Sleeping Early Makes You Taller" would be called "Sleeping Early Ju."

After getting even more familiar, when the relationship had reached a certain level where they could joke around and tease each other, they could become more intimate.

For instance, later on, Li Luo always called Xu Youyu "Sister Zao Shui."

Who would have thought, who would have thought, that there would come a day when he would be called "Big shot" by Xu Youyu.

Thinking of this, Li Luo felt an inexplicable sense of satisfaction.

He found it especially amusing to think that Xu Youyu was currently just a web novel newbie, just starting on the path of a struggling author.

The girl chatting with him now, calling him "Big shot," would become one of the twelve Heavenly Kings of the year in five or six years, sign a Great God contract, ascend to godhood, and become a household name in the urban genre.

And right now, she was still a little girl who called him "Big shot" and asked him for chapter recommendations.

Should he take a screenshot of this and save it?

Li Luo thought for a moment, then gave a self-deprecating smile and started typing his reply on the keyboard.

Rekindle: The editor told me. I'll give you a recommendation in tomorrow's chapter.

Sleeping Early Makes You Taller: Then thank you, Big shot! I'll recommend you in my update tonight!

Tsk tsk.

What a cute tone.

Li Luo recalled when he first met "Sleeping Early Makes You Taller" in his past life. Xu Youyu was already a Level 5 veteran author back then, with two books that had over ten thousand subscriptions, and was working on her third new book.

At that time, Xu Youyu was already quite famous in the web novel circle.

The two of them became acquainted also because of chapter recommendations.

Except it was Li Luo who had actively sought out "Sleeping Early Ju" to ask for a chapter recommendation.

In the beginning, Xu Youyu had no intention of teaching Li Luo how to write web novels.

It was purely because Li Luo's writing was too trashy, but some of his writing styles and creative ideas for the entertainment genre were quite interesting, so Xu Youyu had complained a couple of times over QQ.

After some back and forth, the two of them started chatting.

Whenever Li Luo didn't understand something, he would go ask Xu Youyu.

Whatever Xu Youyu said, Li Luo would do.

She told him to scour the charts, so he went through the top hundred entertainment novels on the urban genre chart.

She told him to deconstruct outlines, so he meticulously deconstructed the outlines of popular books and studied them earnestly.

Only after seeing that Li Luo was truly willing to put in the hard work did Xu Youyu start to seriously analyze specific problems with him.

After all, many struggling authors would verbally express their desire to learn and improve, but in reality, they took no practical action.

I'm already writing web novels. I came into this either hoping to strike it rich after writing a simple, popular novel, or to write what I think is a literary novel to capture a large following. You still want me to work hard?

That was probably their mentality.

Those who were truly willing to study seriously and diligently write every day could, after a few years, at least make a few thousand yuan a month to support themselves.

Unless they genuinely lacked talent in this area.

Li Luo recalled the past, a nostalgic look in his eyes. He glanced at Xu Youyu's QQ profile picture and continued to type his reply on the keyboard.

Rekindle: I've read your book. It's very well written. Keep it up, and your results will be better than mine.

In the room next door, when Xu Youyu saw this message, her heart immediately filled with joy. The corners of her mouth couldn't help but curl up, and her little feet, crossed on the chair, subconsciously curled their toes. Her whole mood brightened.

At least you have good taste!

Xu Youyu hummed a little tune, the feeling of being praised making her feel pleased in both body and mind. She then started typing on her keyboard.

Sleeping Early Makes You Taller: Not at all, Big shot is the amazing one. I'll have to learn a lot more from you in the future.

The two exchanged a few more polite compliments, then went back to writing.

Li Luo opened the scheduled chapter release page in his dashboard, added the chapter recommendation for The Age of Arts to the end, and then continued to immerse himself in his work.

It wasn't until someone knocked on his bedroom door that Li Luo switched his computer screen to the anime playback window he had prepared earlier, and then called out, "Come in!"

Hearing Li Luo's voice, Ying Chanxi pushed open the door from outside and entered from the hallway, naturally walking over to Li Luo's wardrobe.

"What are you doing?" Li Luo asked strangely, seeing her open his wardrobe.

"Getting my pajamas," Ying Chanxi blinked, pulling a set of pink pajamas from Li Luo's wardrobe. "I'm going to take a shower."

"Wait..." Li Luo looked astonished. He stood up from his chair, walked to his wardrobe, and looked inside, completely shocked. "Why are your clothes in my wardrobe?"

"The wardrobe in my room is so small, I couldn't fit all the clothes I brought," Ying Chanxi said in a small voice. "You have two huge wardrobes in your room, and you only have a few clothes, so I borrowed one."

Li Luo was speechless.

What Ying Chanxi said wasn't wrong... after all, with these two large wardrobes in the master bedroom, it was a stretch to say he used even a tenth of the space.

But for a girl's clothes to be put in a boy's bedroom, wasn't that a little weird?!

Li Luo complained in his head, but Ying Chanxi seemed completely unbothered, hugging her pajamas as she went to the bathroom outside to shower.

Watching Ying Chanxi leave, Li Luo looked at the girl's clothes in the wardrobe, as if he could smell the unique fragrance on them.

Then he slammed the wardrobe door shut, sat back down in his chair, and re-entered his work mode.

About half an hour later, after Ying Chanxi had finished her shower, she walked to Li Luo's bedroom door again and raised her hand to knock.

"Come in!"

Li Luo's computer was playing the anime One Piece. Ying Chanxi glanced over, then walked to the computer in her wet slippers, wearing a set of adorable pajamas.

"What is it now?" Li Luo turned his head and asked.

"Didn't I say so before?" Ying Chanxi blinked. "I need to set a password on your computer."

"Oh, alright then." Li Luo moved out of the way, and Ying Chanxi sat down in his chair and began setting the password.

"The password is 0314." Ying Chanxi tilted her head to look at him. "It's my birthday, easy to remember, right?"

"Yeah..." Li Luo nodded, then paused for a moment. "Didn't you say I was in charge of my computer time? Then why tell me the password?"

"That was just for Senior Sister Xu and Zhao Rongjun to hear," Ying Chanxi looked at him with an innocent face, a smile blooming. "This way, the next time Auntie comes over, we can be on the same page and say you don't know the password, so the computer can stay in your room."

"Chanxi."

"...Hmm?"

"For such a great kindness, I have no way to repay you. If there is a next life, I will surely work like an ox and a horse to repay this kindness!"

"Get lost," Ying Chanxi rolled her eyes at him, exasperated. "You'd be better off helping me blow-dry my hair."

"So that was your true motive," Li Luo said with a look of sudden realization.

"Are you looking to die?" Ying Chanxi glared at him through gritted teeth and jumped down from the chair.

Seeing this, Li Luo turned on his heel and bolted.

"Don't run if you've got guts!"
